import unittest
from events.bus import EventBus

class TestEventBus(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_pub_sub(self):
        bus = EventBus()
        res = []
        s1 = bus.subscribe('order.**.created', lambda t, p: res.append(p))
        bus.publish('order.created', 10)
        bus.publish('order.us.east.created', 20)
        self.assertEqual(res, [10, 20])
        single = bus.subscribe('order.*.created', lambda t, p: res.append(p))
        bus.publish('order.us.created', 25)
        bus.publish('order.us.east.created', 26)
        self.assertEqual(res, [10, 20, 25, 25, 26])
        single.unsubscribe()
        s1.unsubscribe()
        self.assertEqual(len(bus._subs), 0)
        bus.publish('order.created', 30)
        self.assertEqual(res, [10, 20, 25, 25, 26])

if __name__ == '__main__': unittest.main()
